tools.name: estimate_max_mortgage
tools.description: Indicative maximum mortgage for one or two applicants, calculated with the same rules as Hanno's full calculation. Returns the norms and year used. Information, not advice.

tools.name: estimate_monthly_costs
tools.description: Monthly payment in the first month (interest and repayment) for a given amount, rate and term: gross, and net after Hanno's flat 37% tax relief on the interest (the answer states the rate and its tax year in assumptions). Information, not advice.
